claims.evidence: Witness shows a gearbox/transfer-case assembly with bellhousing area exposed, but make/model/part number (M272) is not readable and completeness (all sensors/bolts/covers) is not confirmed.
Photos show surface condition and internal components visually, but no operational test results (shifts/engagement/noise) are shown.
No audio/video or test run is provided in the witness report.
Mileage/usage history is explicitly not shown/readable in the witness report.
Photos show wear/grime and exposed areas, but cannot confirm whether it has been opened before.
Origin/ownership history is not shown in the photos or witness observations.

claims.claim: Discount if you're ready to buy
claims.evidence: This is a pricing negotiation statement; no photo evidence relates to it.

risks.risk: Wrong identification/compatibility (M272 may not match the actual unit shown; could be a different gearbox/transfer-case variant or different vehicle application).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped/engraved ID plate or part number on the casing (and/or the gearbox tag) plus a photo showing the transmission type/2WD-4WD markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly incompatible used gearbox/transfer-case assembly (worst-case compatibility risk).

risks.risk: Not actually complete (missing sensors, bolts, covers, linkage, or internal components not visible in the exposed photos).
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing all sides of the unit, every port/connector, and a checklist photo of included parts (sensors/solenoids, covers, mounting hardware).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts may be missing.

risks.risk: Internal wear or damage not detectable from surface visibility (gear tooth wear, bearing play, shaft scoring, clutch/torque-converter condition).
risks.proof: Video of a bench test or at minimum a teardown inspection photo showing gear teeth condition and bearing play, plus a measurement/inspection sheet if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven mechanically (worst-case internal wear).

risks.risk: Oil leaks/seal failure (seals/gaskets may be compromised even if not obvious in the photos).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket/seal areas and any wetness, plus a clip showing the unit after cleaning (or a leak test result).

risks.risk: Condition worse than it appears (heavy grime/scuffs could indicate prior issues, contamination, or rough handling).
risks.proof: Before/after cleaning photos and a wipe-test showing whether grime is just external or indicates seepage around seams/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case external condition and potential contamination.

risks.risk: Seller may be overstating testing/working status (no evidence of operational test; photos alone cannot confirm).
risks.proof: A short video of the unit being run/tested (engagement/shift behavior) or a written test report with timestamps and results.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the stamped/engraved part number/ID plate on the casing (readable).
Photos of all ports/connectors and mounting points from multiple angles to confirm completeness (no missing sensors/solenoids/covers).
Video or evidence of a bench test showing engagement/shift behavior (and ideally no abnormal noise).
Photos of gasket/seal areas and any signs of oil seepage (plus a wipe/clean-and-check clip).
If available: a document or label showing origin (Belgium) and mileage/usage history.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a gearbox/transfer-case assembly with bellhousing and internal components visible, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. However, make/model, completeness, and working/test claims are not verifiable from the report, so the price should assume unknown compatibility and unproven mechanical condition.
